name: Google (Gmail)
description: Read and send Gmail via a local MCP server, authenticated with your Google account through OAuth.

auth.instructions: 1) In Google Cloud Console, create an OAuth 2.0 Client ID (Desktop app type) with the Gmail API enabled, and download it as gcp-oauth.keys.json. 2) Enter the path to that file below. 3) The first time the server runs it will open a browser window for you to sign in and consent - the resulting token is cached locally so you won't need to log in again.
